Governance Risk Compliance

Processus de contrôle

A series of coordinated actions and procedures implemented to manage and mitigate risk by enforcing policies and security requirements.

Questions and answers

What is Processus de contrôle?

In this glossary, Processus de contrôle refers to: A series of coordinated actions and procedures implemented to manage and mitigate risk by enforcing policies and security requirements.

How is Processus de contrôle used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Des processus de contrôle efficaces nécessitent une surveillance régulière et une réponse rapide aux écarts de performance attendue."
